name: Position Vector
description: Learn about Position Vector and its applications in physics.

content.overview: Think of a pin dropped on a map, connected back to your house by a straight string. That string, pointing from home to the pin, is basically a position vector. {{viz:diagram-01}}
keyPoints: A position vector always starts at the origin and points to the object's current location {{viz:diagram-02}}
Written as r = x î + y ĵ, using the object's coordinates as components
The difference between two position vectors, Δr = r₂ - r₁, gives you the displacement
content.whyItMatters: Position vectors are the starting point for describing motion - velocity and acceleration are both built by tracking how the position vector changes over time. Get this one solid and kinematics clicks into place much faster.
